statements.subject: message
statements.description: The URI in the To field of the request MUST be set to the remote URI from the dialog state.
actions: Set To URI to dialog remote URI

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The tag in the To header field of the request MUST be set to the remote tag of the dialog ID.
actions: Set To tag to dialog remote tag

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The From URI of the request MUST be set to the local URI from the dialog state.
actions: Set From URI to dialog local URI

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The tag in the From header field of the request MUST be set to the local tag of the dialog ID.
actions: Set From tag to dialog local tag

statements.subject: message
statements.description: If the value of the remote or local tags is null, the tag parameter MUST be omitted from the To or From header fields, respectively.
statements.post_cond: (dialog.remote_tag = null & request.To_tag = absent) | (dialog.local_tag = null & request.From_tag = absent)
actions: Omit tag parameter from To header if dialog remote tag is null
Omit tag parameter from From header if dialog local tag is null

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The Call-ID of the request MUST be set to the Call-ID of the dialog.
actions: Set Call-ID to dialog Call-ID

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: Requests within a dialog MUST contain strictly monotonically increasing and contiguous CSeq sequence numbers (increasing-by-one) in each direction (excepting ACK and CANCEL of course, whose numbers equal the requests being acknowledged or cancelled).
actions: Assign strictly monotonically increasing and contiguous CSeq value

statements.subject: session
statements.description: Therefore, if the local sequence number is not empty, the value of the local sequence number MUST be incremented by one, and this value MUST be placed into the CSeq header field.
actions: Increment dialog local sequence number by one
Place incremented local sequence number into CSeq header field

statements.subject: session
statements.description: If the local sequence number is empty, an initial value MUST be chosen using the guidelines of Section 8.1.1.5.
actions: Choose initial local sequence number value per Section 8.1.1.5

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The method field in the CSeq header field value MUST match the method of the request.
actions: Set CSeq method field to match request method

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the route set is empty, the UAC MUST place the remote target URI into the Request-URI.
actions: Set Request-URI to remote target URI

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The UAC MUST NOT add a Route header field to the request.
actions: Omit Route header field from request

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the route set is not empty, and the first URI in the route set contains the lr parameter (see Section 19.1.1), the UAC MUST place the remote target URI into the Request-URI and MUST include a Route header field containing the route set values in order, including all parameters.
actions: Set Request-URI to remote target URI
Include Route header field with full route set values in order with all parameters

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the route set is not empty, and its first URI does not contain the lr parameter, the UAC MUST place the first URI from the route set into the Request-URI, stripping any parameters that are not allowed in a Request-URI.
actions: Set Request-URI to first URI of route set with disallowed parameters stripped

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The UAC MUST add a Route header field containing the remainder of the route set values in order, including all parameters.
actions: Add Route header field containing remaining route set values in order with all parameters

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The UAC MUST then place the remote target URI into the Route header field as the last value.
actions: Append remote target URI as last value in Route header field

statements.subject: client
statements.description: A UAC SHOULD include a Contact header field in any target refresh requests within a dialog, and unless there is a need to change it, the URI SHOULD be the same as used in previous requests within the dialog.
actions: Include Contact header field in target refresh request
Use same Contact URI as previous requests unless change is needed

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the "secure" flag is true, that URI MUST be a SIPS URI.
actions: Set Contact URI to a SIPS URI
